questions.question: In the parable of the wedding feast, what happened to the man who came without wedding clothes?
options: He was clothed in fine new wedding garments
He was bound and cast into outer darkness
He was quietly seated at the lowest table
He was forgiven and welcomed to the feast
questions.answer: He was bound and cast into outer darkness
